title: World population growth summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Ritchie, Rodes-Guirao, Roser), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data figures (CC-BY): ~1 billion in 1800 to >8 billion today (eightfold); growth peaked >2%/yr in the 1960s, since more than halved to <1%; ~108 billion people have ever lived, of whom today's 8 billion are ~7%. Clean version verified internally consistent (8/1 = 8x; 2% halved -> ~1%; 8/108 ~= 7%) before injecting 3 defects findable from the text's own numbers.
